//: Story Phase 13: inspect scripts and doors. The treasure room is never opened.

else: The treasure-room door. DO NOT OPEN, in Gristle's big shaky letters. Under it, newer: YES, SERIOUSLY. Under that, in Squawks' clawprint on a bit of crate: BAD CLOUD.

then: Brogath is in there. (Allegedly.) As long as the door stays shut, he can't blast the treasure away. (Pete says.)
else: Behind it is everything the first release left. It's still in there. Now and then it growls.

p13.inspect.quarters_door: The old quarters' door, open again. The boards are stacked against the wall, nails and all, in case.

then: From inside, a faint crackle of toy sashes as somebody turns over.

p13.inspect.cable_galley: Garrick's cable, tacked across the galley floor under a strip of sash-box cardboard: TRIP HAZARD. (NOT A JOKE.)
jim: (from the stove, not turning round) Mind the cable.
p13.inspect.cable_cannon: Three turns of television cable round the starboard cannon. 'For grounding.' Nobody is to fire this cannon. There's a note on it now, in Gristle's hand: DON'T.

then: The bedroom set, on the barrel table, the grille on its side open and breathing out the programme. NOW IN STENCH-O-VISION!
else: The bedroom set, on the barrel table: the Stenchmaster Channel logo, a crown, a sash and a nose. The grille on the side is shut. Mostly.
The bedroom set: a miniature television on a barrel. Three of Jim's forks on top for an aerial. Snow. NO SIGNAL.

p13.inspect.locker: The linen locker, boarded over. DO NOT OPEN. IT GROWLS.

then: captain: (to the locker) I KNOW what you are. I KNOW.

p13.inspect.megapack: The Grand Stenchmaster Fan Mega-Pack box, empty now except for straw and a leaflet: COLLECT THEM ALL! (YOU HAVE.)

then: The little shelf. A candle stub. A book called KNOTS. Behind KNOTS, where nobody will ever look: the Spicy Stench Sauce.
else: The little shelf: a candle stub, a book called KNOTS, and a can of Spicy Stench Sauce somebody brought down for later.

p13.inspect.sash_bunk: Sash hammocks, red and gold. Sash pillows with little noses on. Sash blankets with AGES SIX AND UP round the edge.
It's the most comfortable the crew have been in a month. You will never, ever say so.
p13.inspect.wardrobe: Your wardrobe. The sash is in there, behind your good coat. The good coat is a slightly different colour at the hem than it was this morning.
♪ Don't throw my sash in the trash... ♪ It's in your head. It's in your HEAD.

then: The cardboard princess turns her head. Slowly. To look at YOU. (It's cardboard. It doesn't. It DID.)
else: Princess Stenchalina, in cardboard: a baby in a crown with her fist raised, staring at somebody's bunk with great intensity.

then: Brogath. Cardboard Brogath. He's blushing. He's always blushing. What has he got to blush ABOUT? (He's cardboard.)
else: Brogath the Bashful, life-size, cardboard, blushing behind his own sash. CHEAP-O-RAMA on the back.

then: Garrick's cable is still round his neck, over his shoulder and under his arm.
Brogath. Cardboard Brogath. He's blushing. He's always blushing. What has he got to blush ABOUT? (He's cardboard.)
else: Brogath the Bashful, life-size, cardboard, blushing behind his own sash. CHEAP-O-RAMA on the back.

then: Rumpold's printed rear is pointing at the weather. It is, you're almost certain, getting READY.
else: Rumpold Windbreaker the Resolute, printed from behind. Rear to the weather. As is traditional.

then: Sir Rumpus's finger is up. It's been up all day. Is the Court in SESSION?
else: Sir Rumpus Windbottom in his great wig, one finger raised. A speech bubble: THE GRAND WAFT IS VALID.

then: Lord Gustavio is horrified. You look where he's looking. You're horrified too.
else: Lord Gustavio Bottomsworth, in a sash, looking at a sash in absolute horror. Whatever he faces, he's horrified by it.
